MPESB MP Police HC Computer and ASI Computer Practical Exam Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Practical Exam Admit Card for the post of Head Constable (Computer) and Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI). This recruitment was released for 89 posts. Applications for the MP Police MPESB ASI & Head Constable (Computer) Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 05 February 2026, to 19 February 2026. The pre examination was held on 24 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination download their MPESB MP Police HC Computer and ASI Computer Practical Exam Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 February 2026
  • Last Date : 19 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 February 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 05-24 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 18 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 26 March 2026
  • Result : 08 May 2026
  • PPT Result : 23 July 2026
  • Practical Exam Admit Card : 09 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
